reviews.title: Notion Plus — Paid but Unreliable
reviews.text:
I purchased a full year of Notion Plus for $119.99 through Apple.

Unfortunately, my experience has been extremely disappointing. The app repeatedly displays confusing information about my subscription, connecting it to ChatGPT has been unreliable, and copying and pasting large documents frequently fails or becomes unresponsive.

I purchased Notion to organize and preserve six volumes of my research manuscripts, but even transferring text has become unnecessarily difficult.

I expect a paid productivity application to provide reliable basic functionality. Please address these issues and provide a clear explanation.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
[!TL;DR] I strongly advise against using this AI powered workspace application. I loved and used Notion for years (despite certain limitations), but the egregious pivot toward an AI focused identity has become incredibly detrimental to the overall user experience.
___
Notion was initially a workspace I loved and used extensively (for work/academics/personal) for years. However, their decision to push numerous incredibly *intrusive* AI features on top of replacing essential UI components with AI toggles, have really left me with immense frustration. Their identity has become almost entirely focused toward AI while neglecting their core pre-existing features. I often used to recommend/introduce others to Notion (including the agency I prev worked at), and even built templates for these individuals and businesses. I am incredibly disappointed in what it’s become and am actively transitioning to an alternative system. Personally, this app and its team are no longer worth supporting considering their intense love for such an inhumane system of AI implementation, and  consistent disregard for its user experience.

reviews.title: Unintuitive bloat
reviews.text:
One of the most unintuitive apps I’ve ever used. Even the AI assistant built-in can’t answer simple questions. 

I literally just want to create a kanban style board to track projects in 4 stages but there is no ability to add a 4th step in the board. It just defaults to the “not started”, “in progress”, and “done” steps. 

Apparently online I’ve read that there is something called statuses and I need to update my database… what database? I have created nothing. This app is god awful and incredibly hostile to users. 

Try making a less convoluted app.

reviews.title: Lacking in Functionality
reviews.text:
I enjoy the/Laptop app, but on phones and ipads it just feels clunky and lacks a lot of the quick functionality features that make it a good tool. For me, especially with ADHD, it starts to feel less like an organization and note taking app, and more like an extra task in it of itself. 

I think these would make a huge difference :

— bulk photo delete 
— bulk tab moving 
— command buttons (could use the 3 lines at the bottom.)
— more intuitive ways to organize (charts, calendars, etc are quite difficult to use in app.)

reviews.title: Notion is NOT okay (updated review)
reviews.text:
The app is incredibly buggy. Transitioning from my laptop to my phone is such a painful experience. The Notion app is riddled with glitches and bugs. For example, when I create a database and add multi-select options, trying to hold down on one of the options to move it (I sometimes switch the options to be in a certain order) causes the page to spazz out of control and start auto-scrolling back to the top and it doesn’t stop unless I tap out of the page and reenter. This wasn’t an issue before, I could move multi-select options whenever, so why is it happening now? I can’t help but feel like the effort put into maintaining the user experience in the desktop version, whilst adding in new features, isn’t being applied to the app version, which is very disappointing. Creating a great platform for team communication and personal organization, only to have the app’s experience be so glitchy and frustrating, is disheartening. I love Notion and what it has helped me accomplish, but please, take better care of the app. It’s a shame to see so many bugs crawling around such a nice app. 😞
UPDATE 8/13/26: I genuinely cannot stand this app anymore. Forget the Ai updates, can you please just make the app usable?! Please?? This is such a horrible experience on both iPhone AND iPad

reviews.title: Wish it didn’t have AI
reviews.text: Had to delete because of the AI. Obviously AI is not only terrible for the environment (uses so much water without recycling it) and contributes to cognitive decline (our brains need to stretch and work doing even “simple” things to build and maintain key neural pathways), it’s also a massive security risk AND the generative aspect of it straight up just doesn’t work, like you end up typing like four or five prompts in and faffing about refining the result that it would have taken less time just to write whatever you were trying to make the AI write. As much as I hate AI, I really really loved Notion and I would have kept it if they’d have some option for toggling off the AI features. They’re just really obtrusive and obnoxious for how useless/harmful they are, like I don’t want an AI assistant helping me write and stealing my content. But rather than remove or add an off-switch, the developers just kept cramming more AI slop in there, so I’ve had to delete it. It’s such a crying shame. I recalled loved Notion. I’d come back in a heartbeat if they ditched the AI slop.

reviews.title: AI might be good for some, but for me it was the end.
reviews.text:
Years ago, I was recommended this note tool via word of mouth. I initially loved it! Being able to switch between devices as I needed was a big plus for my writing, and I loved the stacking folders and clean ui. 

I had no need for ai when it launched. It was unobtrusive, however, so I carried on. Then, a badly implemented update caused a piece of writing I had worked on for hours to, with an easy keyboard stumble, be completely rewritten. Completely. Hours of work chewed up and spit out into slush. :/ I promptly closed the app and stopped writing in it.  

Years later, I have found a software I like better, with no intrusive ai and no cloud services, so my notes are no longer at risk in a server I don't have access to. I have zero faith that notion has kept anything I ever wrote secure. They continue to say one thing and do another. I am done. 

In logging in to transfer my notes, I notice that the program is buggy and slow in ways it never was years ago. Buffers like crazy. It's actually kind of heartbreaking to see how far this app has fallen.

There are better options out there, with more security and better customization. Even if you want ai in a notes app, there are more clean and helpful options that do not compromise your experience. Why pick notion? I never will again.

reviews.title: Gen AI is BAD, FORCED PAYMENT
reviews.text:
So basically the constant advances and pushing of AI from the app itself has been increasing constantly to the point where, you’ll accidentally click on the AI stuff and it tries to force you to use it. 


This is only ONE of the negatives, but the worst part is once you run out of free storage you are FORCED to purchase more storage or you have to just make a new account altogether. This is because even if you delete things to make more space it doesn’t actually give you your storage back meaning, you deleted it for nothing because you still don’t have any space. Once you run out of space it prevents you from actually being able to even add bullet points or any feature outside of typing and even that is limited. You can’t add anything at all once you run out of storage, deleting things doesn’t give you more storage, and you literally have 0 other options. This is horrible, like genuinely everyone should find better alternatives because this is just ridiculous, personally I WILL be finding alternatives and stop using notion.

reviews.title: Another Poor iPad Version
reviews.text:
It’s wild to me that the iPad version of this app is as poorly optimised as it is. After getting a nice big iPad to handle simple notes, journals, and other organisation, I sort of assumed Notion would’ve figured out a satisfying experience to mirror all the other instances. Maybe I had my expectations out of whack. It’d be one thing if it was just the iPhone app (still disappointing) but certain functions just straight up don’t work, and major ones no less, like simply moving sections around.

I want to love Notion, but it’s so disappointing to know that something so well suited to the purpose of Notion as the iPad (at least, in my opinion) clearly isn’t a priority.

But hey, at least their shareholders got another AI chat bot to peddle in meetings.
